subject: Pilot onboarding — flexible PO authorization proposal (Novalytics)
messages:
From: Samantha Ellis <samantha.ellis@novalytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurex-ops@novalytics.com
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request (Novalytics)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Novalytics is excited to kick off a four-week pilot that integrates Redwood into our ingestion pipeline. We can get the technical side ready quickly, but our procurement team has a strict PO-first policy for vendor onboarding which would delay access.

To get started faster, can Redwood accept invoice-only billing for the initial 90-day pilot (estimated spend ~$8k), with the understanding that a PO will be issued if we move to a paid subscription after the pilot?

I attached our onboarding form and a W-9. If you need any other vendor data (SOC2, encryption details, payment contact), tell me what to send and I’ll loop procurement.

If this is possible, we’d like to start on Monday, July 12. Please let me know what approvals/controls you need on your side to make this temporary carveout acceptable.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Ellis
Head of Vendor Ops, Novalytics
Attachment: novalytics_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: novalytics_w9.pdf (pdf)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ellis <samantha.ellis@novalytics.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request (Novalytics)

Hi Samantha — appreciate the quick turnaround and the materials. Short answer: we can consider a temporary invoice-only path for the pilot with a few guardrails.

Proposed temporary arrangement (90 days):
- Invoice-only billing for pilot (estimated <= $10k).
- Novalytics agrees to Net30 payment terms for invoices during the pilot.
- Redwood requires a named payment contact and a PO to be issued if pilot converts to a subscription.
- Novalytics must provide SOC2 report or a security checklist within 14 days of pilot start (we can accept an upload to the shared procurement folder).
- Redwood will add a formal exception record in our procurement system tagged: temporary_invoice_only and attach evidence (onboarding form, W-9, SOC2).

I’ve looped Laura (procurement) and Marcus (finance) to confirm the internal approval path and any additional documentation they need. Laura — can procurement approve a delegated exception for a pilot of this size if Novalytics provides the security evidence and signs a short MSA addendum? Marcus — will finance be ok with Net30 for the pilot invoices?

If we get internal sign-off today, we can provision access for July 12 as requested. I’ll prepare a draft addendum to close the risk gap and share it for signature (DocuSign ok).

Thanks,
Rafael
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-msa-addendum-draft.docx (docx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Ellis <samantha.ellis@novalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request (Novalytics)

Rafael — thanks for the summary. Quick procurement guidance:

- Standard policy: PO required for all vendor spend. Exceptions can be granted for pilot engagements under $25k on a case-by-case basis.
- Approval criteria for a temporary invoice-only exception:
  * Evidence pack (onboarding form + W-9 + SOC2 or equivalent) on file;
  * Risk owner (sales lead) signs the exception request;
  * Exception recorded in PROC system with an explicit expiration (max 90 days).

I can approve a one-time exception for Novalytics if we get the SOC2 (or a completed security checklist) within 14 days and the redwood-msa-addendum is executed. Please use the temporary-exception-template.docx so procurement can capture the required fields (deal id, expected spend, approvers, expiration). I’ll then raise the exception ticket and add the tags.

Marcus — will finance need a PO on day one for accounting reasons or can they accept the invoice-only during the exception window?

Laura
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachment: temporary-exception-template.docx (docx)
From: Samantha Ellis <samantha.ellis@novalytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, procurex-ops@novalytics.com
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request (Novalytics)

Rafael / Laura — thank you, that sounds workable. Novalytics will:
- Provide SOC2 Type II report to your procurement folder by July 20;
- Have our legal sign the MSA addendum via the DocuSign link you send;
- Provide a named payment contact (Finance — payables@novalytics.com).

We’re fine with the 90-day expiration and the temporary_invoice_only tag. I’ll populate your temporary-exception-template and upload it to the PROC ticket once you create it.

What I need from Redwood to proceed:
1) Confirm approval (so we can notify our procurement team),
2) Send the DocuSign addendum link,
3) Create the PROC- ticket so we can reference it in our internal docs.

Thanks — excited to get started on July 12.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Vendor Ops, Novalytics
Attachment: (none)
